stackDivergence.rationale: Task113 adds ScCondFormatItem index/default/copy/move/equality/Clone/hash values and ScPageScaleToItem width/height/default/copy/Clone/validity/member transport. Actual shared SortedVector primitive initializer lists sort without deduplicating, primitive copies preserve all entries, and moves transfer ordinary JS array references. The scalar unsigned32-key o3tl hash helper binds identity hashing with 32/64 seed arithmetic; general std::hash and binary hash parity are not claimed. Actual shared UNO Any handles native output and extraction, including signed16 -1 reinterpretation as unsigned65535. Plain browser unsigned16 scalar transport remains explicit. Public page-scale default0,0 differs from actual DocPool explicit1,1. Conditional implicit copy retainsWhich while Clone restores154; page-scale copy and Clone retainWhich187 or changed source identity. Localization/presentation/XML diagnostics/native caches/debug/ABI/invalid casts/general class-value vector copying/full document/UI/ODS integration remain pending or excluded. No C++ generator, sanitizer or memory management engine. Existing shared owners are reused; source responsibility split only addresses the enforced file-size limit.
